title: Text Size Setting
description:
Adds readability options to the game's own settings menu: text size, card text size, an easy-to-read font, bold text, wider spacing, and high-contrast cards and tooltips.

[h2]How to use[/h2]
Open [b]Settings > General[/b]. You'll find these new rows:
[list]
[*][b]Text Size[/b]: use [b]-[/b] / [b]+[/b] to pick anything from 70% to 200% for everything except cards.
[*][b]Card Text Size[/b]: the same, just for cards.
[*][b]Easy-to-Read Font[/b]: switches the game's text to Atkinson Hyperlegible, a font the Braille Institute designed for low-vision readers. Letters that look alike (I, l, 1) are made clearly different.
[*][b]Bold Text[/b]: makes all text thicker so it stands out against busy backgrounds.
[*][b]Wider Text Spacing[/b]: adds a little space between letters and between lines, which many people with dyslexia or low vision find easier to read.
[*][b]High-Contrast Card Text[/b] and [b]High-Contrast Tooltips[/b]: bright white text with a thick black outline, on cards and/or in pop-up tooltips. Coloured text keeps its colour, just brighter. Nothing else changes.
[/list]
Changes apply right away, even in the middle of a battle, and are remembered next time you play.

[h2]What it changes[/h2]
Text across the game's interface: cards, menus, tooltips, the HUD, events and more. Text never spills out of its button, box or frame, and never pushes an event's options off the screen. Where a box has room for another line, text wraps to stay big; where space is really tight, it grows as much as fits.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
No other mods required. Doesn't change gameplay or saves, and only changes how text looks on your own screen. Languages the readable font doesn't cover keep the game's own font. Unsubscribe to remove it and everything goes back to normal.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
